title: Retention purge cascade: deleting a {{red:workflow_run}} deletes its children
headSub: ADR-070. Purging a run on workflow_runs_days cascade-deletes every run-scoped child row. Observability tables are also swept earlier on observability_days; the run cascade catches any remainder. reports and run_metrics (one per run) go with the run too.

nodes.title: per-(run, job) + per-run rows
nodes.sub: job_scores - review_rounds - resume_reviews - career_advice - interview_prep - tailored_resumes (+ decision cols) - resume_clinic_reviews - human_decisions - reports - run_metrics

nodes.title: observability rows
nodes.sub: step_executions - agent_events - llm_calls (also swept on observability_days; cascade catches any remainder)

takeaway.text: One delete, full cleanup: the run is the cascade root, so {{red:purging it}} removes every child row in one transaction - no orphaned scores, reviews, or telemetry left behind.
